headline: Chip and AI Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch

writeup.headline: Chip and AI Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Blowout Jobs Report Complicates the Fed's Next Move. The big swing: chip and AI stocks rallied early, then turned around after 9:46 AM and are now lower on the day — Yahoo Finance points to “AMD Stocks Surge 11.01% as Chip Buyers Return After AI Rout”. The AI names are up and the average stock is flat: stocks are moving together. Defensive sectors are leading cyclical ones, and the S&P has held its gains all session.

themes.headline: Chip and AI stocks gave back their early rally
themes.detail: Up 6.3% at 9:46 AM, now +3.9%; hardest hit since: Nvidia, Advanced Micro Devices. In the news: “AMD Stocks Surge 11.01% as Chip Buyers Return After AI Rout” (Yahoo Finance).

themes.headline: S&P has held its gains
themes.detail: Low at 9:35 AM, high at 9:53 AM; +0.7% since the open.
